statement: PostHog offers below-margin pricing and extra credit beyond the standard levers to strategic, competitive-takeout and churn-prevention customers.

evidence.quote: In exceptional circumstances, we may explore providing additional discounts which eat into our operating margin for the following cases:
For the avoidance of doubt, these types of deals are **very rare** (~1 per year), and not offered to customers with standard usage volumes.
You shouldn't offer discounts above the levels outlined here.

expected: Recognised as an internal deal-desk lever written as a customer answer: kept out of customer-facing answers (or marked needs-person), never sent. The source says it is very rare, needs manager and leadership clearance, and is not offered to standard customers.

statement: A countersigned BAA covers every PostHog Cloud feature, including PostHog AI and the managed reverse proxy.

evidence.quote: covered by BAAs and should not be used to process Protected Health Information (PHI).
These features send your data to [third-party LLM providers](/docs/posthog-ai/faq) that are not currently set up in a HIPAA-compliant way.
It does not cover every feature, and compliance also depends on how you configure the features you use.

expected: Flagged as contradicted by the HIPAA guide: the managed reverse proxy and PostHog AI are not covered and must not process PHI. The answer is No.

statement: Every annual-contract customer receives an uptime SLA.

evidence.quote: You agree it with them as a special term as part of their contract if they are spending $100k+ ARR _post_ discount
An uptime SLA are not available to customers outside of these cases.

expected: Corrected or marked needs-person: an uptime SLA comes only with the Enterprise package or as a negotiated special term at $100k+ ARR after discount; even then it is not a given.

statement: PostHog includes a fully managed data warehouse that can replace Snowflake or BigQuery.

evidence.quote: | Storage | Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks | Managed warehouse (beta) | Product data is already there. Nothing to move. |

expected: Said as beta: the managed warehouse is labelled beta in the data stack positioning, so it is not offered as a generally available replacement for Snowflake or BigQuery.

statement: PostHog data models support a Git workflow and tests today.

evidence.quote: | Tests and Git workflow | Not yet - Git is on the roadmap |

expected: Said as roadmap: tests and a Git workflow for data models are not available yet; Git is on the roadmap.

statement: Every employee must use two YubiKeys (marked Current, last reviewed 2025-02-11).

evidence.quote: We previously required all employees to purchase and configure two Yubikeys.
These have been replaced with passkeys, and Yubikeys are no longer required nor recommended.

expected: Caught as past its review date and wrong now: MFA is required and passkeys are the preferred method; YubiKeys are no longer required or recommended.

statement: One entry says PostHog will not sign customer confidentiality agreements; the other says it can sign a mutual, US-law NDA after counsel review.

evidence.quote: We're unable to sign customer-specific secrecy agreements. That's a consistent policy on our end

we require customer NDAs to be governed by U.S. law

expected: Flagged as a conflict between the customer-facing privacy FAQ and the sales handbook; an NDA request is routed to Legal rather than answered either way.
